title: agent.steering.hit v1
description: One finding or measurement from a steering plugin hook (prose-guard, prose-compare, reply-score, copy-audit). The plugin appends the record to a local hits.jsonl; adapters/steering-hits mirrors each line into the bus. Consumers (reflex-recorder) trend the counts before and after a ruling change. Carries counts, rule names and paths only; never sentences, ask text or file contents.

path.description: Relative or absolute file path, empty when none

action.description: report: findings shown to the agent. block: the hook sent the agent back once. none: measured only.

rules.description: Finding count per rule name (ste_check.py or copy-audit rule names)

lost.description: prose-compare only: counts ste_check.py --compare reports as lost
